scenario: quality-N seeds; one open day at tick 2 vs no intervention

definitions.activityDiversity: mean distinct location/action-kind combinations per NPC across 28 steps
definitions.fourStepRepeatRate: fraction of 4-step windows with exactly the same location/action-kind
definitions.crisisRate: fraction of NPC steps with energy <10 or hunger >95 after action
definitions.planFulfillmentRate: unique fulfilled meal agreements / accepted meal agreements
definitions.interventionChangedWorldRate: final positions/relationships differ from the no-intervention control; RNG cascades may contribute
definitions.beliefRevisionRate: revised personal interpretations / all sourced personal interpretations; an explanation is not guaranteed to be accepted
definitions.beliefSourceErrors: interpretations whose source event is missing or was not experienced by the owner; must be zero
definitions.activityFulfillmentRate: held NPC-organized gatherings / proposed gatherings; requires preparation and actual attendance
